data.name: Kariman
data.gender_notes: Kariman is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is honored and respected. The name Kariman carries the meaning “Graceful, Honored” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Kariman usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, honored and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the spiritual journey of seeking respect and honor in one's community and within oneself.
data.etymology: Kariman belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, Honored.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kariman total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: كريماًن
in_arabic.meaning: كريماًن تعني الشخص الذي يتميز بالكرم و السخاء
in_arabic.long_meaning: كريماًن هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ك-ر-م' الذي يعني الكرم و السخاء. يعتبر الكرم من الأخلاق الرفيعة في الإسلام، و الشخص الذي يتميز بهذه الصفة يكون محبوباً عند الله و الناس. ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة آيات تشير إلى أهمية الكرم و السخاء، مثل 'وَأَطْعِمُوا الْقَرِيبَ ذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ' (النساء: 36)، مما يعزز قيمة هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: کریمان
in_urdu.meaning: کریمان مطلب ہے جو شخص کریم و بخشنده ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: کریمان ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'ک-ر-م' کے روٹ سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے کریم یا بخشنده۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ کریم و بخشنده ہونا مسلمانوں کی ایک اعلیٰ صفت سمجھا جاتا ہے۔ قرآن میں بھی کثرتِ مروت اور سخاوت پر زور دیا گیا ہے، جیسے کہ 'وَأَطْعِمُوا الْقَرِيبَ ذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ' (النساء: 36)، جو اس نام کی اہمیت کو مزید 부רות کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: करीमान
in_hindi.meaning: करीमान का अर्थ है जो व्यक्ति उदार और दयालु है
in_hindi.long_meaning: करीमान एक अरबी नाम है जो 'क-र-म' मूल से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है उदार या दयालु। इस्लामी संस्कृति में यह नाम बहुत महत्व रखता है क्योंकि उदार और दयालु होना मुसलमानों की एक उच्च गुण माना जाता है। कुरआन में भी उदारता और दया पर जोर दिया गया है, जैसे कि 'وَأَطْعِمُوا الْقَرِيبَ ذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ' (النساء: 36), जो इस नाम के महत्व को और बढ़ाता है।

in_pashto.name: کریماًن
in_pashto.meaning: کریماًن معنی یې دا دی چی کریم او سخي وي
in_pashto.long_meaning: کریماًن د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی، چی د 'ک-ر-م' په ريښه باندي ولاړ دی، او معنی یې ده کریم یا سخي. په اسلامي کلتور کې دا نوم ډير اهميت لري ځکه کریم او سخي کیدل د مسلمانانو د لوړو اخلاقو څخه شمیرل کیږي. قرآن کريم هم د مروت او سخاوت په اړه ټینګار وکړی، لکه 'وَأَطْعِمُوا الْقَرِيبَ ذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ' (النساء: 36)، چی د دې نوم اهميت نور هم زیاتوي.

in_english.name: Kariman
in_english.meaning: Kariman means a person who is generous and charitable
in_english.long_meaning: Kariman is an Arabic name derived from the root 'k-r-m', which signifies generosity and charity. In Islamic culture, being generous and charitable are considered high moral virtues. The Quran emphasizes the importance of charity and generosity, such as 'and feed the needy and the poor' (76:8) and 'give to the near relative' (4:36), which highlights the significance of this name. Kariman reflects qualities of kindness, compassion, and benevolence.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: کري-مان

data.cultural_impact: The name Kariman holds a high status in Islamic culture, as it is derived from the Arabic root words "karimah" and "karim," meaning "noble" and "generous." People with this name are prestigious, respectable, and appreciated in their communities. In Middle Eastern and North African societies, the name Kariman is often associated with aristocracy, class, and prestige.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Kariman has significant spiritual significance in Islam, as it reflects the qualities of kindness, generosity, and nobility. The name is often connected to God’s kindness and generosity towards His creation. Kariman serves as a reminder for individuals to emulate these divine qualities and reflect God’s benevolence towards others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Graceful, Honored" symbolizes One who is honored and respected. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Kariman serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of graceful, honored.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Kariman was a famous poet during the Abbasid Caliphate in the 9th century. The name Kariman carried significant weight in that era.
